firm.name: Pacific Risk Advisors Ltd
firm.summary: Pacific Risk Advisors is an ESG and sustainability risk consultancy for the global investment and business community. Founded in Hong Kong in 2005 by James Pearson, who has advised on environmental and social risk in Asia since 1992 and in Europe from 1988. International advisors are paired with local resources to cover an investment from first screening to exit.
firm.position: PRA bridges the gap between ESG operational and technical issues and maximising investor returns.
firm.operating_statement: PRA runs on agents. Software agents read, search, draft and log. PRA advisors scope the work, visit the sites, make the judgements and sign every deliverable.
memberships: Signatory of the Principles for Responsible Investment (PRI)
Associate of the Inogen Alliance, a global alliance of environmental, health, safety and sustainability consultancies

stages.label: Before you commit
stages.summary: Know what you are buying. Diligence on the target, its sites and its neighbours, measured against the standards your investors and lenders apply.

stages.label: While you hold
stages.summary: Put the findings to work. Systems, action plans and monitoring that reduce risk across the holding period and show it in the reporting.

stages.label: When you exit
stages.summary: Carry the record to the buyer. Disclosure, positioning and planning that let the ESG work support the price.

operating_model.principle: Advisors lead. Agents do the legwork.

agents.name: Engagement memory
agents.does: Holds a decade of PRA proposals, budgets and project records as one structured record per engagement. Every figure names the file it came from.
agents.client_benefit: Your brief is matched to the closest past engagements, so scope, team and fee rest on PRA's real history and not on one person's recall.

agents.name: Proposal desk
agents.does: Reads your terms of reference in full, researches the target from public sources, and drafts scope, programme and budget from the closest precedents.
agents.client_benefit: A scoped proposal reaches you sooner, with the open questions listed and the right person named against each.

agents.name: Document desk
agents.does: Reads data room files in full: Word, PDF, Excel, scans and images, in 24 languages, with translation. Revisions come back as tracked changes.
agents.client_benefit: Nothing in the data room goes unread because it was long, scanned or in another language.

agents.name: Field capture
agents.does: Logs site visit photos, voice notes and observations to the engagement on the day they are taken.
agents.client_benefit: Findings are written up from a complete record of the visit, and each one links back to what was seen.

agents.name: Agent door
agents.does: A Model Context Protocol server that answers your own AI agents on PRA's capabilities, standards and coverage, and takes an enquiry on your behalf.
agents.client_benefit: If your team works through an AI assistant, it can brief PRA without a form or a phone call.

safeguards.title: A named advisor signs every deliverable

safeguards.title: Nothing leaves PRA without approval

safeguards.title: Every figure cites its source
safeguards.detail: Each number and finding traces to the file, page or cell it came from. Gaps are flagged, never filled by guesswork.

safeguards.title: Your files stay under PRA's control
safeguards.detail: Client documents sit on PRA's own systems under PRA's permissions. When a model reads a document it does so under commercial terms that bar training on it.

safeguards.title: Public and confidential are kept apart
safeguards.detail: The public agent and the MCP server see published information only. Client work is never within their reach.

faqs.a: PRA advises investors, lenders and operating companies on environmental, social and governance risk across the life of an investment. Before a deal: due diligence on the target and its sites. During the hold: management systems, action plans and monitoring. At exit: disclosure and positioning. The firm was founded in Hong Kong in 2005 and has advisors in 29 countries.

faqs.q: We are a fund acquiring a manufacturer in Vietnam. What would you cover?
faqs.a: A typical scope has three parts. One: a desk review of the target's permits, records, media and regulatory history. Two: site visits by a PRA advisor with a local specialist, covering environmental, health and safety, labour and community issues. Three: a report that measures the findings against the standards your investors apply, such as the IFC Performance Standards, with each risk costed and an action plan. PRA has advisors in Vietnam.

faqs.q: Which standards do you assess against?
faqs.a: Most often the IFC Performance Standards, the Equator Principles, the ADB Environmental and Social Standards and the EBRD policy, together with ILO labour standards, World Bank Group guidance, DEG criteria and the UN Sustainable Development Goals. PRA is a signatory of the Principles for Responsible Investment.

faqs.q: How does PRA use AI agents?
faqs.a: Agents do the reading, searching, drafting and logging. Advisors do the scoping, the site work and the judgement, and sign every deliverable. In practice: an engagement memory holds a decade of PRA's proposals, budgets and projects as structured records, a proposal desk drafts scope and budget from the closest precedents, a document desk reads every file in the data room in 24 languages, and field capture logs site visits as they happen.

faqs.q: Is my data used to train AI models?
faqs.a: No. Client documents sit on PRA's own systems under PRA's permissions. When a model reads a document it does so under commercial terms that bar training on it. The public agent on this site and the MCP server see published information only, never client work. A named advisor reviews and signs everything that leaves the firm.

PRA has offices in Hong Kong and Bangkok and advisors in 29 countries: 14 across Asia Pacific, 6 in the Americas, 4 in the Middle East and Caucasus, 3 in Africa and 2 in Europe. As an associate of the Inogen Alliance, PRA can also draw on member firms on every continent.

faqs.q: Can my AI agent talk to PRA directly?
faqs.a: Yes. PRA runs a Model Context Protocol server. Point your assistant at the endpoint and it can look up PRA's capabilities, standards and coverage, search the public knowledge base, and send an enquiry on your behalf. No key is needed for public information.

faqs.q: What is an ESMS, and do you build them?
faqs.a: An Environmental and Social Management System is the set of policies, procedures and responsibilities a fund or lender uses to screen, approve and monitor investments for E&S risk. PRA builds them for funds and financial institutions, often through technical assistance programmes, and designs the assurance and audit programmes that keep them working.

Yes. Climate risk assessment is part of PRA's sustainability strategy and diligence work. For asset-level physical risk, PRA works with Intensel, a Hong Kong climate analytics firm whose platform models flood, typhoon, heat, sea level rise and other hazards and puts a value at risk on each asset.

faqs.q: How do you help at exit?
faqs.a: PRA prepares the ESG record for sale: pre-exit management and positioning, disclosure, and a plan for what follows. For a listing, that includes preparing internal systems for sustainability indexes such as the Hang Seng Sustainability Index and FTSE4Good.

faqs.q: How do I start an engagement?
faqs.a: Send a brief: the target or portfolio, the countries, the standard you need to meet and your timetable. PRA matches it to comparable past work and replies with a scoped proposal. Fees depend on scope and are quoted per engagement. Use the form on this page, email enquiries@pacificriskadvisors.com, or call Hong Kong on +852 2603 6690.
